newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: ATHLETICS-OLYMPIC CHAMPION RIBEIRO IN LONG WALK TO FATIMA SHRINE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-OLYMPIC CHAMPION RIBEIRO IN LONG WALK TO FATIMA SHRINE.

text.p: Portugal's 10,000 metres Olympic champion Fernanda Ribeiro on Saturday fulfilled a promise made at the Atlanta Games to walk from home to the Roman Catholic shrine of Fatima to thank the Virgin Mary for her triumph.
Ribeiro, accompanied by her trainer Joao Campos, began the 178-km journey from Oporto to Fatima on Tuesday, signing autographs along the way.
"It wasn't very difficult, even though I broke a toenail...," she said.
Many Catholics make the pilgrimage to honour promises made to the Virgin Mary, who they believe appeared to three peasant children at Fatima on several occasions in 1917.
